messages:
rachel: Noticed another onboarding hiccup: our Go sampleapp with cursor-prefetch is hammering the token endpoint when a refresh happens mid-pagination. Seems different from the js issue earlier.
nikhil: can you share the minimal repro?
rachel: Yep. Run sampleapp with PREFETCH=8 and set TEST_TOKEN_TTL=3s. After page 2 the token expires and every worker does a full refresh -> ~8 concurrent refresh calls -> auth rate-limit.
rachel: Logs:
```
2026-02-15T09:14:02Z INFO prefetch spawn=8 active=8
2026-02-15T09:14:05Z WARN token_provider: ttl_expired=true
2026-02-15T09:14:05Z INFO token_provider: refreshing token
2026-02-15T09:14:05Z ERROR auth refresh 429 TooManyRequests backoff=0s
2026-02-15T09:14:05Z ERROR request page=3 refresh_failed
```
tori: Sounds similar class of bug: no single-flight on refresh + high concurrency. Go SDK has older TokenProvider interface that returns a token string; it doesn't expose a Refresh() hook we can coordinate around.
nikhil: So we need two things: SDK-level single-flight (one inflight refresh, others wait) + sampleapp conservative defaults and a short-circuit limiter around auth refresh.
rachel: Agreed. Suggestion list:
- Add SingleFlightRefresh to Go SDK token provider (optional interface)
- Fall back to app-level mutex if provider doesn't implement it
- Default prefetch in Go sampleapp -> 4 (was 8) for onboarding image
- Add exponential backoff + jitter for immediate retries in refresh path
- Add quickstart note: prefer server-side refresh or long-lived session for onboarding demos
- Add CI test that fuzzes token TTL and asserts <3 auth refresh calls per second per session
nikhil: I'll prototype SingleFlightRefresh as an opt-in interface in go-sdk, with a channel-based waitlist. Also add a metrics hook so we can graph refresh contention.
tori: For short-term, sampleapp change + README note is low risk. For long-term, single-flight is better. Also consider adding a small in-process token-bucket limiting calls to token endpoint to 1/sec per session.
infra-bot: ALERT: auth-service thundering-protection triggered 2026-02-15T09:14:06 for client=sampleapp-onboard (rate limit).
rachel: Adding issue RED-5799 and assigning @nikhil for SDK PR and @tori for sampleapp change.
nikhil: Quick question: do we change defaults in SDK or keep sampleapp only?
tori: Keep SDK stable for now. Sampleapp should be conservative. When SingleFlightRefresh lands, we can bump SDK default if we want.
nikhil: ETA: PR by EOW for the SingleFlight shim and a unit test. I'll also include an opt-in env var GO_SF_REFRESH=true for QA.
rachel: Thanks. I'll add the CI fuzz test and update the onboarding doc. Ping here when PRs are ready so QA can run staging e2e. :seedling:
